 Resident Evil Veronica Reportedly Delayed Due to Requiem Feedback
 November 11th, 2026 at 8:22 am by Solomon Thompson 
 Given the quality of the remakes, fans have high expectations for Resident Evil Veronica . However, it seems the game announced at Summer Game Fest may take longer to arrive than originally expected.
 Although Capcom has never announced an exact release date, giving a general 2027 launch window, the latest rumors suggest the remake may have been delayed internally.
 According to well-known insider Dusk Golem , Capcom had been working under intense pressure to release Veronica in the first few months of next year (Q1 2027). However, it seems the company will not be able to meet its original plans.
 According to the insider, the game was first pushed back to Q2 2027, then delayed again until the fall. This change also appears to be the reason why a new trailer, which was reportedly already finished, has not yet been shown.
 Apparently, these delays have also affected the Resident Evil Requiem expansion . They seem to be linked to Capcom’s desire to fix even the smallest issues following feedback received after the launch of the latest RE installment.
 In short, the situation appears to be quite complicated. There’s still a possibility that Capcom could delay the game even further, pushing its release into 2028. As more information becomes available, we’ll make sure to let you guys know. Until then, follow us on Facebook for more horror gaming news.
